owned-jvm-values:
    name: Owned JVM values, transfers, borrows and receivers
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 240
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact revision
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: npm
      - name: Install Nix
        uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v31
      - name: Install dependencies without lifecycle scripts
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Bound apt network waits
        uses: ./.github/actions/bounded-apt
        timeout-minutes: 1
      - name: Install apt dependencies for Prepare the pinned native compiler
        timeout-minutes: 20
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y build-essential zstd m4
      - name: Prepare the pinned native compiler
        run: |
          bash scripts/bootstrap-toolchains.sh --lean-only
      - name: Install the TAP log verifier
        timeout-minutes: 20
        run: sudo apt-get install -y ripgrep
      - name: Install C# for the combined Maven receiver build
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.424'
      - name: Install Ruby for the combined Maven receiver build
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.3.12'
      - name: Install the ordinary Java compiler
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '22.0.2'
      - name: Install Maven and the corpus helper packages
        timeout-minutes: 20
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y maven unzip python3-venv pkg-config
      - name: Install the pinned Kotlin compiler
        run: |
          mkdir -p build
          curl -fL --retry 3 --output build/kotlin-compiler.zip https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin/releases/download/v2.2.0/kotlin-compiler-2.2.0.zip
          echo '1adb6f1a5845ba0aa5a59e412e44c8e405236b957de1a9683619f1dca3b16932  build/kotlin-compiler.zip' | sha256sum --check
          unzip -q build/kotlin-compiler.zip -d build/kotlin-tools
      - name: Verify owned JVM values, transfers, borrows and receivers
        run: |
          bash scripts/bootstrap-rust-ci.sh
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_RUSTC="$PWD/.toolchains/rust-1.90.0/bin/rustc"
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_CARGO="$PWD/.toolchains/rust-1.90.0/bin/cargo"
          export CARGO_HOME="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}"
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_PYTHON="$(command -v python3)"
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_RUBY="$(command -v ruby)"
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_GEM="$(command -v gem)"
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_DOTNET="$(command -v dotnet)"
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_JAVAC="$JAVA_HOME/bin/javac"
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_JAVA="$JAVA_HOME/bin/java"
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_MAVEN="$(command -v mvn)"
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_KOTLINC="$PWD/build/kotlin-tools/kotlinc/bin/kotlinc"
          source scripts/env.sh
          LEAN_BRIDGE_OWNED_NATIVE_TEST=1 node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/owned-jvm-runtime.test.mjs tests/owned-jvm-values.test.mjs tests/owned-jvm-layout.test.mjs tests/owned-jvm-kotlin.test.mjs tests/owned-jvm-conversions.test.mjs
          LEAN_BRIDGE_OWNED_NATIVE_TEST=1 node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/owned-jvm-calls.test.mjs tests/verified-jvm-assets.test.mjs tests/owned-jvm-package.test.mjs
          LEAN_BRIDGE_OWNED_NATIVE_TEST=1 node --test tests/owned-jvm-thread-exit.test.mjs
          LEAN_BRIDGE_OWNED_NATIVE_TEST=1 node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/owned-jvm-packaging.test.mjs tests/owned-jvm-coexistence.test.mjs tests/owned-jvm-documentation.test.mjs
          npm run test:owned-jvm-transfers
          test -s build/owned-jvm-transfers/ordinary.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-transfers/reviewed.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-transfer-packaging/ordinary.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-transfer-packaging/reviewed.json
          npm run test:owned-jvm-borrows > build/owned-jvm-borrows.log 2>&1
          cat build/owned-jvm-borrows.log
          rg '^# pass 8$' build/owned-jvm-borrows.log
          rg '^# fail 0$' build/owned-jvm-borrows.log
          rg '^# skipped 0$' build/owned-jvm-borrows.log
          test -s build/owned-jvm-borrows/ordinary.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-borrows/reviewed.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-borrows/borrow-only.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-borrows/ordinary-installed.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-borrows/reviewed-installed.json
          npm run test:owned-jvm-receivers > build/owned-jvm-receivers.log 2>&1
          cat build/owned-jvm-receivers.log
          rg '^# tests 15$' build/owned-jvm-receivers.log
          rg '^# pass 15$' build/owned-jvm-receivers.log
          rg '^# fail 0$' build/owned-jvm-receivers.log
          rg '^# cancelled 0$' build/owned-jvm-receivers.log
          rg '^# skipped 0$' build/owned-jvm-receivers.log
          test -s build/owned-jvm-receiver-core/ordinary.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-receiver-core/reviewed.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-receiver-core/ordinary-plain.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-receiver-core/reviewed-plain.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-receiver-core/ordinary-consuming.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-receiver-core/reviewed-consuming.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-receiver-core/ordinary-unanchored.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-receiver-core/reviewed-unanchored.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-receiver-core/ordinary-package.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-receiver-core/reviewed-package.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-receiver-core/ordinary-resource-package.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-receiver-core/reviewed-resource-package.json
          npm run test:owned-jvm-receiver-gc > build/owned-jvm-receiver-gc.log 2>&1
          cat build/owned-jvm-receiver-gc.log
          rg '^# tests 2$' build/owned-jvm-receiver-gc.log
          rg '^# pass 2$' build/owned-jvm-receiver-gc.log
          rg '^# fail 0$' build/owned-jvm-receiver-gc.log
          rg '^# cancelled 0$' build/owned-jvm-receiver-gc.log
          rg '^# skipped 0$' build/owned-jvm-receiver-gc.log
          test -s build/owned-jvm-receiver-gc/ordinary.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-receiver-gc/reviewed.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-thread-exit/ordinary.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-thread-exit/reviewed.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-runtime/ordinary.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-runtime/reviewed.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-values/public.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-layout/ordinary.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-layout/reviewed.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-layout/scalars-ordinary.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-layout/scalars-reviewed.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-kotlin/composed.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-kotlin/scalars.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-conversions/ordinary.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-conversions/reviewed.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-conversions/scalars-ordinary.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-conversions/scalars-reviewed.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-calls/values-ordinary.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-calls/values-reviewed.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-calls/scalars-ordinary.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-calls/scalars-reviewed.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-calls/signatures-ordinary.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-calls/signatures-reviewed.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-packaging/callbacks-ordinary.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-packaging/callbacks-reviewed.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-packaging/scalars-ordinary.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-packaging/scalars-reviewed.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-packaging/coexistence.json
          test -s build/owned-jvm-packaging/documentation.json
      - name: Preserve owned JVM value acceptance
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: owned-jvm-values-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            build/owned-jvm-runtime/
            build/owned-jvm-values/
            build/owned-jvm-layout/
            build/owned-jvm-kotlin/
            build/owned-jvm-conversions/
            build/owned-jvm-calls/
            build/owned-jvm-thread-exit/
            build/owned-jvm-packaging/
            build/owned-jvm-transfers/
            build/owned-jvm-transfer-packaging/
            build/owned-jvm-borrows/
            build/owned-jvm-borrows.log
            build/owned-jvm-receiver-core/
            build/owned-jvm-receivers.log
            build/owned-jvm-receiver-gc/
            build/owned-jvm-receiver-gc.log
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

- name: Enforce owned JVM value acceptance
        if: needs.owned-jvm-values.result != 'success'
        run: exit 1
